title: Darth Maul
description: A brilliant mastermind, agile swordsman, and deadly Sith Lord, Darth Maul was an apprentice to Darth Sidious during the conflict on Naboo. Dispatched to force the Queen of Naboo to sign a treaty that would make the invasion by the Trade Federation legal, he fought against her Jedi protectors. Though he vanquished Qui-Gon Jinn, he was bisected by Obi-Wan Kenobi—almost fatally.
